subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest on Rs. 8,000 at the rate of 10% per annum in 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 8,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 6 years

**Concept:**

Simple Interest (SI) is calculated using the formula:

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ SI = (8000 × 10 × 6) / 100

⇒ SI = (480000) / 100

⇒ SI = 4800

**∴ The simple interest on Rs. 8,000 at the rate of 10% per annum in 6 years is Rs. 4,800.**
